notes: Metronome grows up: pick separate tones for beat 1, main beats and upbeats (beep, woodblock, tick, clave, cowbell - saved settings), and TYPE any time signature you want - 7/16, 11/8, 13/4, anything up to 32 beats over 1-32. Circle practice gets practical: a Random key mode and a choice of what plays on each key change - tonic chord, I-IV-V-I, or a jazz ii-V-I cadence timed to your tempo.
